# Linear — Style Reference

> Brushed graphite instrument panel lit by one cold lamp. Inter at weight 510 with tight negative tracking, a #08090a canvas, translucent white hairlines at 8% opacity, and color allowed only inside the product it sells.

**Theme:** dark

Values are measured from the live site and normalized; names, roles and recommendations are interpretation. Font lists are independent, not paired by position. Example prompts describe reconstructions, not the site's source code.

Linear uses a luminance-ladder product language. The canvas is #08090a, cards rise one step to #0f1011, inner tiles to #161718, and glass controls float at #ffffff05, so depth is read as tiny shifts in black rather than as cast shadow. The chromatic budget for marketing chrome is zero. The primary action is a #e5e5e6 pill, and every saturated hue, including status dots, diff counts and the #5e6ad2 indigo, is quarantined inside product mockups. Typography is Inter Variable at the off-grid weight 510 for headings and UI labels and 400 for reading text, with tracking tightened to -0.022em at 48px and 64px. The 64/48 step is a Perfect Fourth, and hierarchy comes from five grays running from #f7f8f8 down to #62666d rather than from color or dramatic size jumps. Berkeley Mono supplies the uppercase figure labels. Shapes split along a clear line: 9999px pills for marketing controls, 8px, 9px and 12px corners for app surfaces, and 4px for tags. Hairlines at #ffffff14 do the structural work. The page reads as a running instrument rather than a brochure about one.

## Tokens — Colors

| Jet Canvas | `#08090a` | `--color-jet-canvas` | Body background, footer and the gaps between sections — a black with a hint of blue that sits one step off pure #000000, so hairlines and glass still register against it. |
| Carbon Panel | `#0f1011` | `--color-carbon-panel` | Issue cards, activity cards and the app-frame body (34 uses, the most frequent fill) — the first rung of the luminance ladder, only 7 values above the canvas. |
| Graphite Tile | `#161718` | `--color-graphite-tile` | Chat bubbles, composer wells and nested tiles inside cards — the second rung, reserved for content that sits inside an already-elevated surface. |
| Frosted Glass | `#ffffff05` | `--color-frosted-glass` | Circular icon buttons, toolbar chips and segmented controls (9 uses) — 2% white makes a control that has presence without becoming a surface. Do not raise it above 5% alpha. |
| Slate Muted | `#62666d` | `--color-slate-muted` | Timestamps, placeholder text such as "Reply…", sidebar group headers and figure labels (125 uses) — the tertiary rung, which marks metadata the eye should skip. |
| Steel Caption | `#8a8f98` | `--color-steel-caption` | Body paragraphs, nav links and the trailing clause of the mission headline (188 uses, the most-used text color) — the true workhorse ink of the system. |
| Mist Text | `#d0d6e0` | `--color-mist-text` | Sidebar items, h3 issue titles and feature-section lead paragraphs (120 uses) — a cool secondary that reads as active but not emphasized. |
| Fog Label | `#e2e4e7` | `--color-fog-label` | Icon glyphs on glass buttons and in-app labels (81 uses) — a near-white for small UI marks that need contrast at 14px without the full weight of a heading. |
| Paper Ink | `#f7f8f8` | `--color-paper-ink` | The h1, section h2s, footer column heads and chat text — the brightest ink, rationed for the one thing in each block the reader must see first. |
| Ash Hairline | `#ffffff14` | `--color-ash-hairline` | Card borders, nav divider, tag outlines and section rules (67 uses) — 8% white is the structural line of the whole system and replaces shadow almost everywhere. |
| Iron Rule | `#23252a` | `--color-iron-rule` | Footer top border, inset rings on toolbar controls and outlines on glass buttons — an opaque hairline used where translucency would muddy against a gradient. |
| Dove Fill | `#e5e5e6` | `--color-dove-fill` | The "Sign up" pill, its border, and the light state of filled controls — the only opaque light fill in the chrome, which makes it the system's single lamp. |
| Iris Signal | `#5e6ad2` | `--color-iris-signal` | The send button, @mention chips and selected states inside product mockups — Linear's brand indigo, kept inside the app UI. Do not promote it to the marketing CTA color. |

## Tokens — Typography

### Inter Variable — the single voice for display, UI and body, carried by off-grid weights · `--font-inter-variable`

- **Substitute:** Inter (rsms variable build) at 510, which is the same design, so match the weight exactly. Geist at 500, which draws a touch lighter, so keep it at 500 rather than dropping to 400. Inter Tight at 500 for the display sizes only.
- **Weights:** 300, 400, 510, 590 (the 15 elements set at 500 are normalized into 510)
- **Sizes:** 10px, 11px, 12px, 13px, 14px, 15px, 18px, 20px, 24px, 48px, 64px
- **Line height:** 1.0 at 48px and 64px, 1.17 at 12px UI labels, 1.33 at 20px and 24px, 1.5 at 13px, 1.6 at 15px and 18px
- **Letter spacing:** -1.408px at 64px, -1.056px at 48px, -0.288px at 24px, -0.24px at 20px, -0.165px at 18px, -0.165px at 15px, -0.182px at 14px, -0.13px at 13px, 0px at 12px, -0.15px at 10px
- **OpenType features:** `"cv01"`, `"ss03"` (402 elements)
- **Role:** Weight 510 is the signature. It sits 10 units above Medium, enough to give headlines and labels a firm stroke while staying quieter than the 600 to 700 convention for SaaS headlines. The 64/48 step is a Perfect Fourth (1.333). Below 24px the scale crawls in 1px and 2px steps (12, 13, 14, 15), which marks UI typography rather than editorial typography. Tracking tightens in proportion to size, from -0.022em at display down to -0.01em at 13px. Cv01 and ss03 swap in Inter's alternate 1 and rounded glyphs, which removes the stock-Inter look.

### Berkeley Mono — technical micro-labels and in-mockup code · `--font-berkeley-mono`

- **Substitute:** Geist Mono at 400, IBM Plex Mono at 400, JetBrains Mono at 350. JetBrains draws wider and heavier, so step it down to match Berkeley's narrow, even stroke.
- **Weights:** 400
- **Sizes:** 12px, 14px
- **Line height:** 1.4 at 12px, 1.71 at 14px
- **Letter spacing:** 0px at 12px uppercase, 0px at 14px
- **Role:** The mono is a labeling device, not a reading face. In marketing chrome it appears only as 12px uppercase captions ("FIG 0.1", the logo-row strapline), where it borrows the authority of a technical drawing. The 14px setting (172 uses) lives inside the code-editor mockup, so its count comes from product demonstration rather than page design.

### Type Scale

| Role | Family | Weight | Size | Line Height | Letter Spacing | Token |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| small | Inter Variable | 400 | 10px | 1.4 | -0.15px | `--text-small` |
| caption | Berkeley Mono | 400 | 12px | 1.4 | 0px | `--text-caption` |
| body-sm | Inter Variable | 400 | 13px | 1.5 | -0.13px | `--text-body-sm` |
| body | Inter Variable | 400 | 15px | 1.6 | -0.165px | `--text-body` |
| body-lg | Inter Variable | 400 | 18px | 1.6 | -0.165px | `--text-body-lg` |
| subheading | Inter Variable | 590 | 20px | 1.33 | -0.24px | `--text-subheading` |
| heading-sm | Inter Variable | 400 | 24px | 1.33 | -0.288px | `--text-heading-sm` |
| heading | Inter Variable | 510 | 48px | 1.0 | -1.056px | `--text-heading` |
| display | Inter Variable | 510 | 64px | 1.0 | -1.408px | `--text-display` |

## Do's and Don'ts

### Do

- Build hierarchy from the five-step gray ladder #f7f8f8, #e2e4e7, #d0d6e0, #8a8f98, #62666d — a ladder of luminance steps is the system's substitute for color emphasis.
- Set headlines and UI labels at weight 510 with -0.022em tracking at 48px and 64px — the off-grid weight is the signature and holds authority without shouting.
- Split a section headline into two inks, opening in #f7f8f8 and continuing in #8a8f98 at the same 48px weight 510 — the color shift carries emphasis that would otherwise need a second size.
- Outline every card with 1px #ffffff14 — the 8% white hairline is the structural line and does the separating work shadows do in conventional systems.
- Step surfaces in sequence: #08090a, then #0f1011, then #161718 — each nested layer rises exactly one rung, so depth is legible without blur or shadow.
- Keep marketing controls at 9999px and app surfaces at 8px, 9px or 12px — the shape split tells the reader whether they are touching the site or the product.
- Enable `"cv01"` and `"ss03"` on every Inter element — the alternate glyphs remove the default Inter fingerprint across all 402 elements.

### Don't

- Don't make the primary CTA indigo #5e6ad2 — the chrome runs on zero hue, and a colored button turns a luminance-led system into a conventional SaaS template.
- Don't bold headlines to 700 — at 64px a 700 weight reads as advertising, while 510 is the quiet authority the whole system depends on.
- Don't introduce a colored gradient or glow behind sections — color belongs only to product data inside mockups. This is non-negotiable, because a hue-free frame is the thesis.
- Don't render body copy in #f7f8f8 — paragraphs belong in #8a8f98 at 15px, and full-white body text flattens the ladder so headings lose their lead.
- Don't add drop shadows to flat cards on the #08090a canvas — `--shadow-lg` is reserved for panels floating over imagery, and shadowed flat cards smear into the black.
- Don't open line-height above 1.0 on 48px and 64px headings — the tight 1:1 lockup with -1.056px and -1.408px tracking is what makes multi-line headlines read as blocks.
- Don't set the micro-labels in Inter — the 12px uppercase Berkeley Mono caption in #62666d is the engineering-drawing cue, and it should never be replaced with sans caps.

## Agent Prompt Guide

**Quick Color Reference**

- canvas: #08090a (Jet Canvas)
- card surface: #0f1011 (Carbon Panel)
- primary text: #f7f8f8 (Paper Ink)
- body text: #8a8f98 (Steel Caption)
- metadata text: #62666d (Slate Muted)
- hairline: #ffffff14 (Ash Hairline)
- primary action: #e5e5e6 (filled action)

**Color in Data**

Saturated hues appear in data only as 8px solid dots, 1px-stroke icons or fills tinted to 10% opacity behind a full-strength number (the diff counts sit on mockup-internal tints #00ff051a and #f34e521a). Bars and axes stay neutral in #8a8f98 and #62666d, so no chart outshouts the #f7f8f8 headline.

**Example Component Prompts**

1. Build a Primary Action Button: a pill with border-radius 9999px, height 32px, padding 0 12px, background #e5e5e6, 1px solid #e5e5e6 border and text #08090a, set in Inter Variable at 13px weight 510 with line-height 32px and font-feature-settings "cv01", "ss03". Apply box-shadow `rgba(0,0,0,0) 0px 8px 2px 0px, rgba(0,0,0,0.01) 0px 5px 2px 0px, rgba(0,0,0,0.04) 0px 3px 2px 0px, rgba(0,0,0,0.07) 0px 1px 1px 0px, rgba(0,0,0,0.08) 0px 0px 1px 0px`. Do not use any hue; it must be the only light-filled element on the page.

2. Build a Navigation Bar: position fixed, top 0, full width, 73px tall, background #08090a, with a 1px solid #ffffff14 bottom border. Place the content in a 1250px centered column. The logo glyph and wordmark in #f7f8f8, 22px tall, go at the left. On the right place link pills (Product, Resources, Customers, Pricing, Now, Contact), each in Inter Variable at 13px weight 400 in #8a8f98 with padding 0 12px, height 32px, radius 9999px and 8px gaps. Follow them with a 1px by 16px #ffffff14 divider, a "Log in" link pill, and the Primary Action Button reading "Sign up".

3. Build a Hero Section on background #08090a with 128px top padding inside a 1250px column. Set the h1 in Inter Variable at 64px weight 510, line-height 64px, letter-spacing -1.408px, color #f7f8f8, left-aligned and broken over two lines. Add a subline at 24px below in 15px weight 400, line-height 24px, letter-spacing -0.165px, color #8a8f98, with a right-aligned link "New" in #f7f8f8 weight 510 followed by "Loops →" in #8a8f98. At 48px below, place an app-frame panel with background #0f1011, a 1px solid #ffffff14 border, 12px radius and box-shadow `rgba(0,0,0,0.25) 0px 2px 32px 0px`, containing a 208px sidebar with 28px rows (13px weight 510, #d0d6e0, 8px radius, padding 0 7px), all over a full-bleed gradient from #08090a to #8a8f98.

4. Build an Issue Card 300px wide: background #0f1011, 1px solid #ffffff14 border, 9px radius, padding 8px 10px 12px 12px, no shadow. Line 1 is the ID "ENG-2085" in Inter Variable at 12px weight 400, color #62666d. Line 2 is the title in 13px weight 510, color #f7f8f8, letter-spacing -0.13px, 4px below. Line 3 is a row of label chips at 6px gaps, each 20px tall with radius 9999px, a 1px solid #ffffff14 border, padding 0 6px and 12px weight 400 text in #8a8f98, plus a leading 8px colored dot (the dot hue is mockup-only).

## Components

### Pill Button — Light (Primary)

**Role:** The single conversion action

A lamp in the dark. The button uses background #e5e5e6, text #08090a, a 1px solid #e5e5e6 border, 9999px radius, 0 12px padding and a 32px height, set in Inter Variable at 13px weight 510 with 32px line-height, and it carries the five-layer `--shadow-md` stack that adds a near-invisible contact edge. This is the system outlier: the only opaque light fill in the chrome. It is allowed because inverting luminance is the one emphasis move that does not spend chromatic budget, and indigo would compete with the product mockups.

### Pill Button — Glass (Secondary)

**Role:** Icon and utility actions

Barely-there glass. The button uses background #ffffff05, glyph color #e2e4e7, a 1px solid #23252a border, 9999px radius, a 28px by 28px footprint with 0 padding, and an inset `--shadow-subtle-2` ring of 5% white for the variant without a border. Text versions take #8a8f98 at Inter Variable 13px weight 400. At 2% white fill it registers as a control rather than a surface. Use it for expand, attach, close and toolbar actions that should sit behind the primary pill.

### Nav Link Pill

**Role:** Top-level site navigation items

Text with a hidden hit area. Each link uses a transparent background, text #8a8f98, no border, 9999px radius, 0 12px padding and a 32px height, set in Inter Variable at 13px weight 400 with 1.5 line-height. The hover fill lands on the same pill geometry as the CTA. Setting the links in the workhorse gray rather than #f7f8f8 is deliberate. It keeps the nav at caption volume, so the hero headline owns the first screen.

### Navigation Bar

**Role:** Fixed global header

A flat black strip. The bar is position fixed, 73px tall, with background #08090a and a 1px bottom rule in #ffffff14. The 22px-tall wordmark and glyph in #f7f8f8 sit at the left. Nav Link Pills sit right of center at 8px gaps, followed by a short vertical #ffffff14 divider, "Log in" as a link pill and "Sign up" as the Light Pill Button. There is no blur effect or color. The bar reads as an application title bar rather than a marketing header.

### Issue Card

**Role:** Main content card, kanban tile

The workhorse card. It uses background #0f1011, text #f7f8f8 for titles at Inter Variable 13px weight 510, IDs such as "ENG-2085" in #62666d at 12px weight 400, a 1px solid #ffffff14 border, 9px radius, 8px 10px 12px 12px padding, a 300px by 96px footprint and no shadow. Label chips sit at a 6px gap along the bottom. The 9px radius is intentionally off the 4px grid: one pixel softer than the 8px inner tiles, so cards visibly nest around them.

### Activity Card

**Role:** Comment threads and event logs

A card with a ring. It uses background #0f1011, a 1px solid #ffffff14 border plus `--shadow-subtle` (a 1px black ring outside the hairline), 9px radius and 12px 16px 16px padding. Author names are #f7f8f8 at 13px weight 510, timestamps are #62666d at 13px weight 400, and body text is #d0d6e0 at 13px weight 400. The doubled edge, white inside and black outside, makes the card cut cleanly out of a gradient backdrop. Use it wherever a card overlaps imagery.

### Chat Bubble

**Role:** Nested message tile inside panels

The second rung. It uses background #161718, text #f7f8f8 at Inter Variable 13px weight 400 with 20px line-height and -0.039px tracking, 8px radius, 10px padding on all sides, no border and the `--shadow-subtle` black ring. The surface step from #0f1011 to #161718 alone separates it from its parent panel. Reserve this fill for content nested inside an elevated surface, and do not use it for top-level cards.

### App Frame Panel

**Role:** Hero product window and floating panels

The product as hero. The panel uses background #0f1011, a 1px solid #ffffff14 border, 12px radius and `--shadow-lg` (0 2px 32px at 25% black), and it sits over a full-bleed gray gradient backdrop. Inside, a 208px-wide sidebar and an issue view divide the space with #ffffff14 rules, and the floating agent panel repeats the same 12px radius and shadow. It is the only place real cast shadow appears, because it is the only object that floats above an image.

### Sidebar Item

**Role:** In-app navigation rows

Dense, quiet rows. Each item is a transparent row 208px wide and 28px tall with 0 7px padding and 8px radius, set in Inter Variable at 13px weight 510 in #d0d6e0, with a 16px line icon at an 8px gap. The active state takes #ffffff05. Group headers such as "Workspace" drop to 12px weight 510 in #62666d with 4px 0 4px 6px padding. The density, 28px rows at 4px rhythm, is the product's own and is reproduced faithfully in the marketing page.

### Model Tag Badge

**Role:** Inline metadata such as model names

A wireframe label. The tag uses a transparent background, text #8a8f98 at Inter Variable 11px weight 400 with 14px line-height, a 1px solid #ffffff14 border, 4px radius, 1px 4px padding and an 18px height. It is the only 4px rectangle among the text-bearing chips. The sharper corner marks it as system metadata ("Opus 5.5") rather than a user-applied label, which takes the pill shape.

### Label Chip — Status Dot

**Role:** Issue labels in mockups

Color in miniature. The chip uses a transparent background, text #8a8f98 at Inter Variable 12px weight 400, a 1px solid #ffffff14 border, 9999px radius, 0 6px padding and a 20px height (estimated), with a leading 8px circular dot in the label hue. The dot colors, such as #eb5757 for Bug, are mockup-internal and not system tokens. Saturation is confined to an 8px area, which is how the page shows a colorful product without coloring the page.

### Mono Figure Label

**Role:** Technical captions and straplines

Drawing-sheet annotation. The label is Berkeley Mono at 12px weight 400, uppercase, 1.4 line-height, 0px tracking, in #62666d, with no background, border or padding. It sits 24px above the isometric illustrations ("FIG 0.1") and 32px below the logo row. The mono caption turns feature diagrams into numbered engineering figures, which brands the product as a precision instrument rather than a lifestyle tool.

### Footer

**Role:** Sitemap and legal close

A black ledger. The footer is full width at 494px tall, with background #08090a and a 1px solid #23252a top border. Column heads ("Product", "Features", "Company") are set in Inter Variable at 13px weight 510 in #f7f8f8 with -0.13px tracking, each 160px wide, and links below use 13px weight 400 in #8a8f98 at 12px vertical gaps. The opaque #23252a rule, instead of the translucent hairline, gives the page a definite floor.

## Do's and Don'ts

### Do

- Build hierarchy from the five-step gray ladder #f7f8f8, #e2e4e7, #d0d6e0, #8a8f98, #62666d — a ladder of luminance steps is the system's substitute for color emphasis.
- Set headlines and UI labels at weight 510 with -0.022em tracking at 48px and 64px — the off-grid weight is the signature and holds authority without shouting.
- Split a section headline into two inks, opening in #f7f8f8 and continuing in #8a8f98 at the same 48px weight 510 — the color shift carries emphasis that would otherwise need a second size.
- Outline every card with 1px #ffffff14 — the 8% white hairline is the structural line and does the separating work shadows do in conventional systems.
- Step surfaces in sequence: #08090a, then #0f1011, then #161718 — each nested layer rises exactly one rung, so depth is legible without blur or shadow.
- Keep marketing controls at 9999px and app surfaces at 8px, 9px or 12px — the shape split tells the reader whether they are touching the site or the product.
- Enable `"cv01"` and `"ss03"` on every Inter element — the alternate glyphs remove the default Inter fingerprint across all 402 elements.

### Don't

- Don't make the primary CTA indigo #5e6ad2 — the chrome runs on zero hue, and a colored button turns a luminance-led system into a conventional SaaS template.
- Don't bold headlines to 700 — at 64px a 700 weight reads as advertising, while 510 is the quiet authority the whole system depends on.
- Don't introduce a colored gradient or glow behind sections — color belongs only to product data inside mockups. This is non-negotiable, because a hue-free frame is the thesis.
- Don't render body copy in #f7f8f8 — paragraphs belong in #8a8f98 at 15px, and full-white body text flattens the ladder so headings lose their lead.
- Don't add drop shadows to flat cards on the #08090a canvas — `--shadow-lg` is reserved for panels floating over imagery, and shadowed flat cards smear into the black.
- Don't open line-height above 1.0 on 48px and 64px headings — the tight 1:1 lockup with -1.056px and -1.408px tracking is what makes multi-line headlines read as blocks.
- Don't set the micro-labels in Inter — the 12px uppercase Berkeley Mono caption in #62666d is the engineering-drawing cue, and it should never be replaced with sans caps.

## Imagery

There is no photography in the page chrome. The dominant imagery is the product itself, rebuilt as live HTML: the issue view, sidebar, agent panel, Slack-style thread and kanban board, all inside 12px-radius #0f1011 panels with #ffffff14 borders. The hero frame floats on a full-bleed raster backdrop, a soft gray gradient that rises from black to roughly #8a8f98 at the base. It is decorative, not a system token. Secondary illustrations are isometric wireframes (stacked plates, cube clusters, ascending fins) drawn in 1px strokes of #62666d on black and captioned "FIG 0.1" through "FIG 0.3". Icons are 16px monoline glyphs. Customer logos are monochrome #f7f8f8, and avatars are 14px circles at 50% radius inside the mockups. The narrative is that the software is the proof, shown working rather than illustrated.

## Layout

Content sits in a 1250px column inside a 1436px frame with 32px gutters. Sections are separated by 128px, stretching to 224px before major feature blocks, and some are divided by full-width #ffffff14 rules. The hero is left-aligned, with the 64px headline over a 15px #8a8f98 subline and a "New / Loops →" link pinned right. Below it sits a 1250px-wide app frame on a gradient backdrop. A 7-column logo row with a mono strapline follows, then the two-tone mission headline, then a 3-column figure grid divided by vertical hairlines. Feature sections alternate a 2-column header (48px heading left, 18px #d0d6e0 lead right) with a full-width mockup. There is no pricing grid on the home page. The nav is fixed, filled #08090a and 73px tall, with the logo left and links, Log in and Sign up right. The footer is a 494px multi-column sitemap. At 375px, drop display to 48px and section gaps to 64px. Density is comfortable.

## Agent Prompt Guide

**Quick Color Reference**

- canvas: #08090a (Jet Canvas)
- card surface: #0f1011 (Carbon Panel)
- primary text: #f7f8f8 (Paper Ink)
- body text: #8a8f98 (Steel Caption)
- metadata text: #62666d (Slate Muted)
- hairline: #ffffff14 (Ash Hairline)
- primary action: #e5e5e6 (filled action)

**Color in Data**

Saturated hues appear in data only as 8px solid dots, 1px-stroke icons or fills tinted to 10% opacity behind a full-strength number (the diff counts sit on mockup-internal tints #00ff051a and #f34e521a). Bars and axes stay neutral in #8a8f98 and #62666d, so no chart outshouts the #f7f8f8 headline.

**Example Component Prompts**

1. Build a Primary Action Button: a pill with border-radius 9999px, height 32px, padding 0 12px, background #e5e5e6, 1px solid #e5e5e6 border and text #08090a, set in Inter Variable at 13px weight 510 with line-height 32px and font-feature-settings "cv01", "ss03". 2. Build a Navigation Bar: position fixed, top 0, full width, 73px tall, background #08090a, with a 1px solid #ffffff14 bottom border. Place the content in a 1250px centered column. On the right place link pills (Product, Resources, Customers, Pricing, Now, Contact), each in Inter Variable at 13px weight 400 in #8a8f98 with padding 0 12px, height 32px, radius 9999px and 8px gaps. 3. Build a Hero Section on background #08090a with 128px top padding inside a 1250px column. At 48px below, place an app-frame panel with background #0f1011, a 1px solid #ffffff14 border, 12px radius and box-shadow `rgba(0,0,0,0.25) 0px 2px 32px 0px`, containing a 208px sidebar with 28px rows (13px weight 510, #d0d6e0, 8px radius, padding 0 7px), all over a full-bleed gradient from #08090a to #8a8f98.

## Luminance Ladder

Every distinction on the page is made by brightness. Text runs through five fixed steps (#f7f8f8, #e2e4e7, #d0d6e0, #8a8f98, #62666d) and surfaces through three (#08090a, #0f1011, #161718), so the reader always knows rank by how much light a thing emits. Three moves break it: a sixth in-between gray such as #a0a0a0, which blurs adjacent steps, a surface lighter than #161718 used for a card, and emphasis by hue instead of by rung. To extend the system, map any new element onto an existing rung. A new tertiary label takes #62666d and a new nested well takes #161718. If something needs more emphasis than #f7f8f8 provides, invert it onto #e5e5e6 rather than inventing a color.

## Color Quarantine

The chrome holds zero saturated hues, while the mockups hold dozens: syntax colors #f79ce0, #f7bf8b, #ffdf9f and #83dcdc in the code editor, red and blue label dots, and green and red diff tints. All of these are decorative and mockup-internal, not system tokens. The discipline is spatial: color may exist only inside a 12px-radius product frame or an 8px status dot. It breaks the moment indigo #5e6ad2 colors a marketing button, a hue-tinted gradient sits behind a section, or a feature heading picks up a brand tint. When a new section needs energy, add more real product UI, with its natural colored data, rather than painting the frame around it.

## The 510 Weight

Conventional SaaS headings run 600 to 700. This system stops at 510 for everything from the 12px labels (55 uses) to the 64px display, and reaches 590 only for 20px issue titles in mockups. The restraint works because tracking compensates: -0.022em at display sizes tightens the counters, so 510 reads dense without reading heavy. Swapping in a static Inter 600 adds about 15% stroke mass and tips headlines into advertising, and so does dropping tracking back to 0. When extending to a new size, interpolate tracking from the existing pairs (-0.01em at 13px, -0.012em at 24px, -0.022em at 48px) and keep the weight at 510.

## Similar Brands

- **Linear** — shares Vercel's near-black canvas and all-gray type ladder with a light pill as the primary action, though Vercel goes to pure #000000 and draws its labels in Geist Mono.
- **Linear** — shares Raycast's tactic of selling a dark desktop tool through pixel-faithful product windows on gradient backdrops, but Raycast spends a saturated red-orange in its chrome, which this system refuses.
- **Linear** — shares Resend's black page with uppercase monospace micro-labels and hairline-bordered cards, though Resend uses more serif display moments.
- **Linear** — shares Cursor's dark-IDE screenshot hero and monochrome customer-logo row, while Cursor's chrome runs warmer and less tightly tracked.
- **Linear** — shares Stripe's habit of numbered technical-figure annotation for feature diagrams, inverted here onto a dark canvas with no brand gradient.
